messages:
eli: Pitch: tiny RAM verifier + content-addressed shards for air-gapped upgrades. no persistent keys, resumable chunked apply, minimal attestation receipt on reconnect.

nora: nice. how do we guarantee atomic switch and safe rollback on power loss?

jorge: plan: stage into /var/lib/redwood/staged-<id> via overlayfs, maintain per-chunk bitmap. write a single activation marker atomically. if marker absent on boot, revert symlink.

anya: what about media tamper risk during shipping?

eli: operator must offline-sign the media image; anchors are shipped with media and include a sequence counter. optional firmware root-of-trust check if present.

jorge: add manifest flags: "retain_previous":N and "fast_rollback":index-only to expose tradeoffs.

ops-bot: action: create RFC + PoC ticket in eng-infra. owners: @eli, @jorge, due: 2026-04-30.

eli: I'll draft the RFC with diagrams, threat model, and a compact proto for receipts. feedback pls.
